c01.title: An karɓi rahoto
c01.writeDown: Ka rubuta wannan lambar ko ka ajiye ta a matsayin hoto. Kana buƙatarta don duba rahotonka.
c01.keepOnPhone: Ajiye wannan lambar a kan wannan wayar
c01.keepOnPhoneHint: Kashe wannan idan wasu mutane suna amfani da wannan wayar.

next.title: Abin da zai biyo baya
next.line2: Duba matsayinsa da lambarka a wannan manhaja, a shafin intanet, ko ta SMS.
next.line3: Idan mai dubawa ya yi tambaya, za ka iya amsa ta lokacin da ka duba.
